Krownlandia Reading Shelf

Inspired by the Library of Alexandria, a community place idea credited to @Jauregui9821 (historical inventory, page 9). This shelf brings existing park readings and activities together outside the 3D world. Open any item in any order.

  • Make and design
  • Read and look closer
  • Solve a puzzle
  • Plan a visit

Make and design

  • Plan a green corner — choose a path, two planting beds, and a bench for an imagined entrance.
  • Plan and tend an imaginary garden — rotate three crops and match garden care to three clues.
  • Village Craft Guide — try village crafts, arrange a Meadowbrook market table, or practice Sewing Club stitches on paper.
  • Arts Sampler — arrange shapes, tell a three-shot story, sketch on a nine-square grid, or frame one scene three ways. The grid is optional; the written prompts also work without JavaScript.
  • Rhythm Sampler — read or tap two four-beat patterns, or choose to hear them.

Read and look closer

  • Labels for an imaginary house museum — write or say a label for one of three fictional objects.
  • A story in three choices — choose a beginning, discovery, and ending from the Whispering Pines workshop.
  • A bench for the story — read a short story about listening and telling a story together.
  • Four Seasons — compare the same imagined park path in spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
  • Gallery Sampler — explore four park-inspired illustrations, each with a text description.
  • Make-believe field notes — imagine more than one explanation for a fictional clue.

Solve a puzzle

  • Share a pizza — split eight imaginary slices using topping and pairing clues.
  • Airtime Puzzle — arrange three imaginary radio segments. Read the clues and solutions or check your order with the optional controls.
  • Crossing Stones — trade ends of a five-space path by sliding and jumping.
  • Krown Bowling on paper — choose two aims and work out which pins stay standing.
  • What comes next? — finish repeating patterns with shapes or words.
  • Share the treasure — solve the Dragons Math Club puzzles on paper or aloud.
  • A choice for the square — compare three imaginary activities and explain what would make one easier to join.

Plan a visit

  • First-visit guide — learn how to start, resume, and find your way.
  • Community Bulletin — read an update about park features.

Reading from this shelf does not record a visit, earn points, or change the Alexandria Bookmark. Those features remain in the 3D park.
